preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in stdin.split()[1:])
preconditions.description: All elements in the permutation p are integers between 1 and n (inclusive).

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.split()) == n + 1 and all(p.count(x) == 1 for x in range(1, n + 1))
preconditions.description: The input contains exactly n distinct integers (a valid permutation p of length n).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in stdout.split()) and len(stdout.split()) == n and all(q.count(x) == 1 for x in range(1, n + 1)))
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, stdout contains exactly n distinct integers between 1 and n (a valid permutation q). Otherwise, stdout is '-1'.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != '-1' and all(int(q[i]) == int(p[int(q[int(q[i]) - 1]) - 1]) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: If stdout is not '-1', the permutation q satisfies q^2 = p, where q^2 is defined as q[q[i]] for each i (1-based indexing).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' if any((p[i] - 1) == i for i in range(n)) else True
postconditions.description: If any element p[i] equals i + 1 (1-based), then no solution exists (output is '-1').
